queries:
WITH account_counts AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        c.town_city,
        COUNT(ft.account_id) AS transaction_count
    FROM Accounts AS a
    JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        transaction_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(AVG(transaction_count) OVER (), 0) AS transaction_ratio,
        transaction_count * 1.0
            / NULLIF(SUM(transaction_count) OVER (PARTITION BY town_city), 0) AS city_share
    FROM account_counts
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY transaction_ratio DESC, city_share DESC) AS account_rank,
    transaction_ratio,
    city_share
FROM metrics
ORDER BY account_rank, account_id

WITH account_counts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id,
         c.town_city,
         COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
  FROM Accounts AS a
  JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
  JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city
)
SELECT account_id,
       1.0 * transaction_count
         / AVG(transaction_count) OVER (PARTITION BY town_city) AS count_ratio
FROM account_counts

SELECT c.town_city, SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS transaction_total
FROM Customers AS c
JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY c.town_city
